i'm trying to learn how to use content patcher. if this works, i'll be relieved ;w;
Content Patcher:
unzip the cp file into the stardewvalley/mods folder and you're good to go!


XNB:
this mod goes in: Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
Backup the original.xnb files if you want, just to be safe. place the Haley.xnb file in the portraits folder (not the characters folder!) replacing the file that was there.

make that cute headcanon canon! this mod only makes slight changes to Haley's face/clothes to make her look a bit chubbier.
